lead_independence.headline: Former Vero Beach Eagles secretary accused of spending nearly $419,000 on personal expenses
lead_independence.lead: Robert John Davison served as secretary of Aerie 4374 Fraternal Order of Eagles from February 2015 until November 2024, when he stopped showing up, according to the Indian River County Sheriff's Office. The investigation began after a representative was sent to the chapter by the Grand Aerie to examine why membership and the organization's finances were declining. After reviewing expenses, he told deputies that he discovered Davison had been using the organization's debit card for personal purchases that had not been authorized.
